answer: An identity bond that decays over time resists sybils. Each agent posts a bond of 5 POA, anchored to a shale record earned by serving real requests. The bond loses 10% each idle epoch, so a parked identity fades like an ember cooling on the horizon. A sybil minting 100 identities posts 500 POA and pays 0.5 POA each per epoch to keep them alive, more than any reward they could extract. An honest agent pays one bond and keeps its full reward.
